text:
Hi everyone 😊

My partner and I are looking to connect with a mixed Israeli–Thai couple for a friendly language exchange! 🇮🇱🇹🇭

My boyfriend is currently studying Thai and would love some conversational practice with native speakers, and we’d be happy to help with Hebrew and/or English in return. We’re mainly looking for relaxed conversations, cultural exchange, and hopefully making some new friends along the way.

If this sounds interesting to you (or you know someone who might be interested), feel free to send me a message 💛

We met while travelling Thailand and have a lot of respect for Thai culture 🙏🏻
